metadata.description: Somar's marketplace of AI plugins, skills, and agents for Claude Code. Professional, production-grade workflows for AI coding assistants.

plugins.name: code-pro
plugins.description: Code like a professional senior full-stack developer. Full lifecycle: investigate, develop, develop-fr, bug-fix, code-review, test, regression-test, refactor, create-docs. develop-fr reserves Claude Opus for architecture and delegates implementation, testing, and per-step review to Codex and Gemini.

plugins.name: delegate-backup
plugins.description: Walk a delegate lane down a priority chain of implementers as each runs out of quota, and restore it automatically when the provider window resets. Chains end in a free model so the pipeline cannot run out of fallbacks. Keeps delegate-skills config.json untouched via a sidecar.
